name: Michael Crawford
source: Emmett’s acquaintance from long ago, and also a new friend in the present. He recently moved back into the state and transfers into most of Emmett’s classes. Michael is on the basketball team and his good talent seems to stick out. He’s grown to be the recent talk of the school, but the unwanted attention tends to make him nervous. Emmett seems to hit it off well with Michael, but there’s a lot he doesn’t know about him…
